vis_data_error.paragraph: We see further signs that the overall RAN market is now stabilizing, with strong growth in North America supporting a return to Networks sales growth in Q4. Progress on operational excellence continued, with commercial discipline and supply chain efficiency actions supporting a strong adjustedGroup gross margin of 46.3% in the quarter. We are not yet at our long-term EBITA goal, but we are progressing towards it, supported by our strategic actions.

facts.fact_content: Adjusted Group gross margin of 46.3% in the quarter.
